title: Build the Mark III's observation, reward and nightly update inside the sim
tier_reason: Layer-2 code behind the unit suite and the replay round-trip; git reverts it.
ask: Per docs/design/06 'The ladder's third rung' and P-14: an observation builder (systems/sim/observation.gd) that reads a data spec (self position on/off, energy on/off, vision radius, channel list) and returns a flat float array, O(radius^2); a reward table (systems/rewards.gd, data layer) applied to before/after world state — +1 for a tile made wet, 0 for everything else (Q-96, ruled 2026-09-09); policy maths (systems/sim/brains/policy.gd, static, JSON-plain arrays); the nightly update in on_new_day; the learned keys carried across configure; a replay round-trip test with weights in the save.
first_action: Start with systems/sim/observation.gd and its test (fixed scan order, strictly-nearer tie-breaks, radius 2 default), then the reward table, then the policy file; wire the day-turn update in BotBrain.on_new_day; add the learned keys to the carry-over list in the configure verb (sim_world.gd) and assert it in test_machines.
source_message: CEO, 2026-09-09, chief of staff session: v0.2.1 is the Mark III, the robot that learns by reinforcement (P-14).
